Downloads and extracts pinned-version Prometheus/Grafana release archives over HTTPS with no SHA256/signature verification before the binaries are later executed locally. — installPrometheus()/installGrafana() call downloadFile() then extractArchive() with no checksum comparison anywhere in ensure-binaries.js or install-utils.js
Hook writes a timestamp line to a fixed path under /tmp on every session start/end. — SessionStart/SessionEnd hook commands append a line to /tmp/ccam-session-timing.log

Hardcoded default admin/admin credentials for the bundled local Grafana instance. — GRAFANA_ADMIN_USER = "admin"; GRAFANA_ADMIN_PASSWORD = "admin"; seeded via grafanaAdminEnv() into GF_SECURITY_ADMIN_USER/PASSWORD
